segments.name: Platform service group
segments.description: Generates revenue by providing information services and reservation services on the So-Young platform for medical aesthetic service providers.
segments.evidence: Segment of platform service group generates revenue primarily by providing information services and reservation services.

segments.name: Aesthetic treatment services group
segments.description: Consists of amounts earned from aesthetic treatment services provided to consumers.
segments.evidence: Segment of aesthetic treatment services group consists of amounts earned from aesthetic treatment services.

segments.name: Wuhan Miracle
products: Sales of medical products and maintenance services
segments.description: Sells medical products and maintenance services, acquired by the Group in 2021, to medical aesthetic service providers.
segments.evidence: Prior to the year ended December 31, 2025, the Group had two reportable segments, namely So-Young and Wuhan Miracle.

segments.name: Others
products: Sales of medical products and maintenance services
segments.description: Sells medical products, provides medical aesthetic services on So-Young Prime and offers insurance brokerage services.
segments.evidence: Others Segment of others generates revenue primarily through sales of medical products, provision of medical aesthetic services displayed on the So-Young Prime, and insurance brokerage services.

revenueModel.text: Medical aesthetic service providers pay for information and reservation services on the platform, and users pay for aesthetic treatment services, medical products and maintenance.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group generates revenue from offering information services primarily to help medical aesthetic service providers better introduce their services and increase their customer base.

changes.text: In 2025 the Group replaced its two reportable segments, So-Young and Wuhan Miracle, with four reportable segments.
changes.evidence: Consequently, the Group presents four reportable segments as set out in Note 24 to reflect the change.
